test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In 2024, what major upgrade did the Indian Air Force (IAF) focus on to enhance its defense capabilities?

options.text: Acquisition of advanced drones for surveillance
Upgrading the Sukhoi-30MKI fleet with new avionics
Expansion of the cyber defense unit

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Upgrading the Sukhoi-30MKI fleet with new avionics**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Sukhoi-30MKI**, a multirole fighter aircraft, serves as the backbone of the **Indian Air Force**.
 
• The upgrade in 2024 focused on equipping the Sukhoi-30MKI fleet with **advanced avionics systems**, enhancing its **combat readiness** and operational capabilities.
 
• The new avionics include **radar systems, electronic warfare suites, and advanced communication systems**, which make the aircraft more effective in modern warfare scenarios.
 
• This upgrade ensures better integration with indigenous weapon systems</stro
